rationale: Compound agent-noun: ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who does') + ϯ ('give') + ⲟⲩⲁⲥⲧⲛ̄ ('expanse, breadth' — root of ⲟⲩⲱⲥⲧⲛ̄ 'be wide,' cf. accumulated ⲟⲩⲉⲥⲧⲁⲛⲧ 'wide/broad'). Cosmic title of the Living Spirit, twice attested on this page (lines 20, 30) as ⲡϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲉϩϯⲟⲩⲁⲥⲧⲛ̄ 'the first Expander.' Confirmed cosmologically by line 28-29 ⲁϩϯⲟⲩⲁⲥⲧⲛ̄ ⲛⲉϩ ⲍⲛ̄ ⲧⲭⲱⲣⲁ ⲙ̄ⲡⲙ̄ⲧⲁⲛ 'and he gave him expanse in the country of rest' — the very act named by the title. Paralleling ⲣⲉϩⲥⲱⲧⲉ 'redeemer' and ⲣⲉϩⲥⲉⲍⲟ ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ 'drawer-upward.' Translation 'Expander' preserves active-emission verbal quality required by the correspondential principle.

Substantival noun functioning as cognate object of ⲥⲱⲡⲥ̄ 'supplicate' in ⲡⲥⲁⲓⲧ ⲉⲧⲁⲥⲥⲁⲡⲥⲧ̄ 'the petition that she had supplicated him for' (line 12). Possibly a Lycopolitan substantival of ⲥⲱⲡⲥ̄ or related to ⲥⲟⲉⲓⲧ 'cry/report.' Translation 'petition' fits both the syntactic role and the prayer-context.
Lycopolitan reflex of ⲧⲟⲩⲱϩ 'add, join, attach.' Used in line 6 of the First Man joining himself to the Mother of Life pre-cosmically. The vowel-form -ⲟⲩⲓ̈ⲁ- shows Lyc. dialectal expansion.

Substantival noun + 3sg.m suffix from ⲧⲱⲃⲉ 'seal, bind.' In line 10 enumerated alongside 'host of demons' as one of the constraining loci surrounding the First Man. Distinct from the homograph ⲧⲱⲃⲍ̄ 'pray' used multiply on this page.
